_comment: Static two-state smFRET (PRD-008). Two species with FRET efficiencies E=0.25 and E=0.75, encoded purely through per-channel brightness q = [(1-E)*b, E*b] on channels [green(donor), red(acceptor)]. Slow, bright molecules (D=0.05 um2/ms ~ a large protein/complex, b=300 kcps) and a dilute population give well-separated single-molecule bursts; run a burst search on the exported TTTR and histogram the per-burst proximity ratio to see two peaks. See examples/simulation/fret_smfret.py.
